latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the invoice-template skill.
- Instantly generate clean, professional invoices with your branding.
- Includes: business and client info, line items, payment instructions, and total due.
- Designed for quick and simple invoicing—no tracking or automation features.
- Suggestions provided for upgrading to more advanced billing tools.
